summary.text: Danny Davis was chosen to represent Illinois's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House on November 5, 1996, and sits on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before Congress he served on the Cook County Board of Commissioners from 1990 and for eleven years as Alderman of Chicago's 29th Ward.
Born in Parkdale, Arkansas, in 1941, he earned a bachelor's degree from Arkansas A.M. & N. College and master's and doctorate degrees from Chicago State University and the Union Institute.
